mission.title: Mod Box
mission.description: Recover a modified Black Box and repair a hardline junction box.

phase.briefing: Thanks to your efforts, we were able to uncover the purpose behind the Black Boxes. The Agents have been using these Black Boxes to damage hardline junction boxes and preventing redpills, such as yourself, from jacking in and out of the Matrix. We need you to pick up the modified version of one of the Black Boxes that Clarissa Babcock is holding onto for you. Pick up the Black Box and additional instructions will follow.

enter.say: This is Clarissa Babcock's lab. Pick up the Black Box from her.

objective.text: Get the Black Box from the Agent

done.say: That's the box we're looking for. Get outside and we'll contact Flood with the good news.

near.say: The Agent must have listened in on our transmission. I'll wager he has the Black Box on him.

phase.briefing: Head to this address and look for a Merovingian operative by the name of Bohrmann. He will take the Black Box from you. You will be working with him to locate a hardline junction box and repair it.

enter.say: Bohrmann should be waiting for you inside.

done.say: Bohrmann is dead! The Agents must have known you were coming... You're going to have to finish this job on your own, {player}. Get out of there and head to the hardline junction box.

phase.briefing:
I am sending you the address of where you can find the hardline junction box.
There are some Agents on the site, so be careful. These Agents do not want you repairing the hardline junction boxes. They will attempt to stop you -- no matter the cost. Be prepared to defend yourself.

enter.say: The hardline junction box should be on a wall.

done.say: You've repaired the hardline junction box!

talk.say: Hey! Have you seen my new computer? It's bad ass! I've been playing Shogo 2 all day long!

objective.text: Take Shogo 2 from Genaro Whitfield's computer

done.say: You stole my copy of Shogo 2! You jerk! I'm going to kill you!
Genaro Whitfield must have really enjoyed that game to try and kill you for stealing it.

mission.finish: You've done very well, {player}. You should be proud of your efforts to support the Merovingian.
